notes.title: New demo level from Overlook Trail
notes.content:
The demo includes a single level from the game, allowing you to explore the dreamlike world of Overlook Trail. In this demo, you take flight on a wind-swept leaf, soaring through a moonlit landscape. As you navigate, you'll dodge obstacles and collect glowing orbs that hint at the game's deeper mechanics. This brief experience captures the essence of the game's tranquil yet adventurous tone, combining arcade-like flight controls with a dreamy visual style.

Douglas Holmquist, the composer of the soundtrack for this level, has shared a video detailing his approach to creating interactive music for this environment, along with his contributions to the overall soundtrack and his collaborations with other composers and musicians.

You can watch it on YouTube here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4gJZIKbIUAM]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4gJZIKbIUAM[/url]

notes.title: The original soundtrack is now available
notes.content:
The original soundtrack is now available on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, and many other streaming services.

It features music composed by Caroline Karpinska, Douglas Holmquist, Niklas Ström, and Pelle Hillström. Vocals by YenTing Lo and Elísabet Einarsdóttir. Cello by Gerda Holmquist.

You can find it on your preferred music provider here:
[url=https://recordu.lnk.to/r634Vk]https://recordu.lnk.to/r634Vk
[/url]

notes.title: Optimized for Steam Deck
notes.content:
Optimized for Steam Deck

Overlook Trail is now working perfectly on Steam Deck. After thorough testing, the game runs at 60 fps on all levels, and controller hints have been implemented and localized. We've really enjoyed playing Overlook Trail on Steam Deck and hope you will, too!

Overlook Trail has simple controls and works just as well with any kind of gamepad as with keyboard and mouse. Playing on a handheld screen isn't any problem either, as the graphics have been adapted for its size, and there's very little text in the game. The form factor of the Steam Deck has turned out to be an awesome match for our game; we hope you'll agree.

Stay tuned for more info from the team at Longhand Electric
